issue: जगजाया: जाया is 'wife' as well as 'she who bears'; the word can be 'mother of the world' or 'wife of the Lord of the world (Śiva)'.
our reading: she who gave birth to the world (the glossary's first sense; the line is a list of the Mother's names)
alternatives: wife of the Lord of the world, Śiva

issue: मद्यपान कीन्हैउ रण गंगा: 'रण गंगा' is not plain. Read as the Gaṅgā of battle, the stream of blood on the field, in which she drank.
our reading: you drank wine in the Gaṅgā of battle, its stream of blood
alternatives: she drank the battle's river of blood as wine; रण गंगा a place name; रण and गंगा separate (in battle … the Gaṅgā)

issue: भजत तुरत काटहु भवजाला: काटहु is the imperative form, but chālīsās also use -हु forms in plain statements.
our reading: a request: as one worships you, cut at once the net of worldly existence
alternatives: a statement: when one worships you, you at once cut the net

issue: अरिदल दलन लेहु अवतारा: लेहु is the imperative ('take'), in a passage that otherwise praises (cau41–44).
our reading: a request: take incarnation to crush the hosts of the enemy
alternatives: a statement: you take incarnation to crush the enemy hosts
